description: Stucki error diffusion onto the 7-colour palette. rgb: hex, 3 bytes per pixel, row-major; indices: one hex digit per pixel, row-major. lift / scale: how often the two range rules fired (information only). Strength 0 is also the expected output without dithering: the exact nearest colour (full 8-bit channels, smallest squared distance, lowest index on a tie), not a search at reduced channel precision; the 'nearest colour boundaries' picture pins colours where the two differ.
